description: This file provides custom memory mapping functions `git_mmap` and `git_munmap` used internally for handling memory-mapped files within the Git project. It includes validation, error handling, and fallback to malloc/free for mapping memory regions.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Creates a memory mapping of a file region, with validation and fallback to malloc if mapping isn't valid.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Releases memory allocated by git_mmap using free.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
